methodology: Read original medic GLB geometry, skin, bones and source animations with GLTFLoader. Disconnect image materials only for Node coordinate sampling. Use actual redblade rigid GLB and unchanged v020 grip calibration; AnimationMixer samples at 120 Hz. This report does not claim visual/browser/gameplay completion.

rigCapabilities.note: Head/neck intent is bone animation. Close/open eye markers are only synchronization cues for the screen close-up; no eyelid or eyeball deformation is present in the original medic.

socket.calibration: v020 immutable Blade_Ready upper + Idle_Subtle lower; RightHand to Middle1 45%

eyeCapability.limitation: Neck/head pitch conveys intention only. Closed/open eyes must be rendered by the separate screen close-up; no eyelid deformation is authored.
